# Week 12 build notes: Capstone, week 3 (scoring, risk register, POA&M)

Light week. Built 2026-11-23 on `course-v2`. Not committed.

## Files
- `course-w12-lessons.js`: talks 12.1-12.4 (12.1 scoring math, 12.2 risks and heat map, 12.3 POA&M and roadmap, 12.4 writing the CSA) + `COURSE_QUIZ.w12` (20 questions; answer positions 5/4/6/5).
- `course-w12-labs.js`: Lab 12.1 Check the Dashboard by hand (fixed practice-client numbers, 9 auto-checked checkpoints + 2 instructor-read); Lab 12.2 Analysis hand-in (the Week 12 deliverable; folder link and key numbers, 1 auto-checked).
- `course-w12-practice.js`: `risk-w12` (14-item sort, dims Rating + POA&M item?; answers verified by script against the matrix and the rule), `acro-w12` (20 acronyms, all from the Student Platform drill list).
- `course-w12-figures.js`: `w12-scoring-chain`, `w12-risk-matrix`, `w12-poam-rule`. Generated by a scratch script (Week 1 palette and helpers); the script was kept outside the repo because this build was limited to the files above. Ask if you want it added as `docs/tools/make_week12_figures.js`.
- `course-w12-mock.js`: `MOCK_W12` with brief, a grader key (formulas, weights, Lab 12.1 answers, matrix, POA&M rule, evidence to look for), and 5 rubric notes. No model scores: the model pack stays outside the public repo (`Documents\mccoe-curriculum\instructor-guide\week9-10-model-pack\`).
- `docs/build/week12.js`, this file.

## Days (estimator, `node docs/tools/estimate_time.js 12`)
Day 1, Finish the scores and turn gaps into risks (238 min):
talk 12.1 (10), score Q18-Q41 (70), Lab 12.1 (20), read SP 1302 (10), gap list (40), talk 12.2 (10), practice risk-w12 (10), risk register + heat map (55), find POA&M candidates (10), daily survey (3).

Day 2, The POA&M, the roadmap, and the CSA report, part 1 (240 min):
talk 12.3 (10), partner check of risk register (20), build the POA&M (70), read CISA CPG 2.0 (10), roadmap (20), Lab 12.2 hand-in (15, due end of Day 2), talk 12.4 (10), CSA part 1 sections 2-4 (65), Week 12 Quiz (15), weekly check-in (5).

Every unmeasured block has a `basis`. Capstone rates used: 3 min per scored question, 5 min per risk row, 2.5 min per POA&M row, 12 words/min for drafting prose.
